about_the_game:
In "Catgirl Kitchen", you take on the role of a terminally ill man down on his luck. One day, he receives a contract from a major food corporation: in 30 days, he must raise a catgirl, bring her happiness, and ultimately turn her into a dish to earn a generous reward. Desperate to survive, he signs the contract without hesitation and begins a story of training this "tool" catgirl.

As time goes on, the man and the catgirl redeem each other. When the contract deadline arrives, he hesitates—should he really go through with it?

Mass-produce ready meals and prepare for tomorrow’s surge in orders!
Use your wits to strategically plan your daily actions within the 30-day limit. Fulfill diverse customer orders, and reinvest your earnings into the catgirl’s development... or into various events along the way!

Pet your catgirl, fulfill her requests, dress her up, take her out to experience the colorful (probably) human world. She will grow gradually by your side, eventually even helping you make money on her own!

Game Features:

  • Predict tomorrow’s orders and mass-produce ready meals today to meet the incoming demand.

  • Random event buffs that assist or hinder you in handling various situations.

  • Multiple growth paths for the catgirl, which not only affect the ending but also impact side stories (and unlock some mini-games).

  • A wide variety of changeable outfits, which affect how she appears in CGs.

  • Time-based progression—as days pass, your catgirl will grow up. A grown catgirl becomes more caring and will wholeheartedly help you manage the takeout shop.

  • Optional side routes—choose your side stories during gameplay. Your choices will directly affect your business strategies.
